column1: # Vulnerable jars bundled in the vendor WAR, and the Maven artifact that
# replaces each one. Applied by files/scripts/patch-war-jars.sh at build time.
# Column 1 is the exact jar the WAR ships. If a VALIDATOR_VERSION bump changes
# any of these filenames the build FAILS rather than silently leaving the old
# jar in place -- re-scan and rebuild this table when that happens.
# Column 2 is the path under repo1.maven.org/maven2. Replacement jars are
# checked against patches.sha256 and must be Java 8 bytecode (class file
# version <= 52; a stray module-info.class at 53 is fine, Java 8 ignores it).
# because the GHSA is fixed on the 2.18, 2.21 and 2.22 branches only.
# jackson-annotations moves in lockstep: a split Jackson version is its own bug.
# CVE-2022-41853. The -jdk8 classifier is required: mainline hsqldb 2.7.x is
